title: Project: sorting a file bigger than memory

exercises.title: External sort
exercises.task: Write ExternalSort: pretend only memory lines fit in RAM. Cut the input into sorted runs, then merge them two by two, round after round, until one run is left. Return the result, the number of runs and the number of merge rounds. The spec is in the file.
hints: Runs: for i := 0; i < len(lines); i += memory, take lines[i:min(i+memory, len(lines))], copy it and sort it (slices.Sort is fine: a run fits in memory).
A round: merge runs 0 and 1, 2 and 3, …; an odd last run goes to the next round as it is. Write merge yourself (1.6.1).
Count the rounds while more than one run is left. 8 runs need 3 rounds, 5 runs need 3 too: it is ⌈log₂ runs⌉.
